name: DOWNHILL START
setup: burrbug at (1460,1135) walking left; no guardian constructs
phenomenon: Runner sprints down the curved grass slope; the one enemy walks up the flat to meet them.
success_means: runner moving right on the slope, burrbug moving left, both in frame

name: ONE ENEMY, ONE LEAP
phenomenon: Runner jumps clean over the burrbug, which skids and turns; the chasm opens ahead.
success_means: runner passes over the burrbug with no hit taken

name: THE CLIFF
move: Pull back to expose deep chasm
phenomenon: Sprint jump + air jump off the lip toward the high far bank.
success_means: runner airborne past x=1540 over the 940px-deep chasm

name: NOT QUITE!
phenomenon: The jump comes up short: the runner drops below the far lip, reaching for it.
success_means: runner below the far bank top (y>1100), x<2240, falling

name: INCOMING CALL
phenomenon: Mid-fall hold. The Discord call card is composited in the edit over the right of frame.
success_means: runner still airborne inside the left 55% of frame

name: YOUR PARTNER ARRIVES
move: Hero and blue cursor in frame
phenomenon: The guardian's blue YOU pointer slides in beside the falling runner (no second avatar).
success_means: guardian aim within 200px of the runner

name: BRIDGE, ON DEMAND
phenomenon: YOU taps a slab under the fall, then draws a rising stroke toward the lip: luminous steps in open air.
success_means: two guardian platforms exist in the chasm

name: JUST IN TIME
phenomenon: The runner lands on the guardian's slab and regains balance.
success_means: Events.runner_landed_on_hologram fired

name: KEEP MOVING
phenomenon: Runner climbs the temporary steps toward the lip.
success_means: runner on a guardian platform, higher than the first catch

name: SAFE SIDE!
phenomenon: Last hop off the steps onto solid grass, signpost ahead.
success_means: runner standing on the far bank (x>2240, feet 1040)

name: ELECTRIC BRIDGE
setup: checkpoint 1; storm machine idle; rod uncharged
phenomenon: Rain and storm backdrop; the runner steps onto the deck and the first strike is called (spans glow).
success_means: storm strike 1 telegraphing

name: A STRIKE!
phenomenon: The bolt lands: flash, shake, span 3 bursts into falling stones in front of the runner.
success_means: deck span 3 non-solid and debris falling

name: ESCAPE THE GAP
setup: continues; second strike opens a double gap
phenomenon: Runner vaults up the broken spans above the double gap; two of them crackle with electricity.
success_means: runner standing on a broken high span while spans 7-8 are gone

name: SHIFTING RUINS
phenomenon: Multi-level ruin: terrace, hall, high ledges, a sand waterfall and the swinging block.
success_means: runner in the hall; sandfall and pendulum in frame

name: SWINGING MASS
phenomenon: The chained stone block sweeps past just over the crouching runner.
success_means: block passes within 60px horizontally above the crouching runner, no hit

name: VERTICAL COLLAPSE
phenomenon: The floor caves in tile by tile; the runner falls down the shaft past sand and falling stones.
success_means: collapse state 1 and runner falling below y=1500

name: VOLCANO CORE
phenomenon: Staggered basalt pillars over the lava lake, hanging chains, a magma slime hopping.
success_means: runner standing on a basalt pillar over the lake

name: HOT PURSUIT
phenomenon: The magma sphere bursts from its tube and rolls down the cracked slope after the runner.
success_means: sphere rolling within 450px behind the runner

name: SWING OVER LAVA
setup: continues; sphere has smashed the crust
phenomenon: Runner leaps onto a chain-hung platform swinging over the lava.
success_means: runner standing on a swing deck

name: BETWEEN THE GEYSERS
phenomenon: An eruption throws the runner's slab up between staggered lava jets.
success_means: runner on a rising geyser lift with a lethal jet active nearby

name: ROOFTOP TRAIN RUN
phenomenon: Runner runs the roofs of the moving train over the viaduct; mismatched roof heights and cargo.
success_means: runner on a roof while the train moves >200px/s

name: TRAIN-TO-TRAIN
move: Show both car roofs; follow jump
phenomenon: Huge leap across the 300-390px gap between the two moving trains.
success_means: runner airborne between trains, then lands on the lead train

name: CRANE DROPS
setup: continues; crane 2 targets the lead train's middle car
phenomenon: The crane's hook flashes red and drops a crate onto the roof; the runner side-steps and uses it as a step.
success_means: crate landed on the lead train within 300px of the unhurt runner

name: FULL-SPEED ROOFTOPS
phenomenon: Sprint along the lead train's roofs; aqueduct and meadow rush past.
success_means: runner on the lead train, train moving

name: INSIDE THE HIVE
phenomenon: Honeycomb hall: tiered ledges, dripping honey, the paddle wheel and swarm.
success_means: runner inside the hive hall

name: STUCK!
phenomenon: Boots sink into thick honey; the run stalls to a crawl.
success_means: runner in a honey pool, |vx| <= 130

name: SWARM AND PADDLES
phenomenon: Climbing the tiers beside the honey wheel while wax wisps close in.
success_means: two or more wax wisps within 320px of the climbing runner

name: BUBBLE SLINGSHOT
phenomenon: The honey bubble bends under the runner, then flings them up.
success_means: bubble squashed, then runner rising faster than 800px/s

name: HIVE SHAFT ASCENT
phenomenon: The honey current carries the launch up the narrow shaft.
success_means: runner rising inside the shaft

name: BREAK THROUGH THE HIVE
phenomenon: The wax membrane bursts; glowing honey debris rains back down the shaft.
success_means: membrane state 1

name: OFF-CENTER LANDING
phenomenon: Drop onto the isolated tilted ledge and recover.
success_means: runner standing on the tilted ledge slope

name: SOMETHING HUGE WAKES
phenomenon: The stone automaton rises out of the gorge across the route.
success_means: giant awake, risen more than half way

name: SWEEP!
setup: continues; slab toppled into a bridge
phenomenon: Jump over the colossal chained mace as it sweeps across the toppled bridge.
success_means: mace passes beneath the airborne runner with no hit

name: THE FOSSIL CANYON
phenomenon: A canyon of enormous fossil ribs; arched rib bridges and rotor skulls.
success_means: runner on an arched rib bridge

name: BONE ARCH RUN
phenomenon: Run up the narrow curved rib high above the canyon.
success_means: runner on the second rib bridge

name: ROTORS EVERYWHERE
phenomenon: Rotor-skull drones hover, wind up and lunge between the ribs.
success_means: three or more skull drones within 450px

name: IT COMES ALIVE
phenomenon: The skeletal beast erupts through the vertebra bridge below, bursting it apart.
success_means: beast state 1, deck vertebrae broken

name: SAND GOES VERTICAL
phenomenon: Sand geysers blast up between collapsing bone pillars as the jaws pursue.
success_means: jaws chasing, a pillar collapsing and a sand jet active in frame

name: CLOSING JAWS
phenomenon: The runner dives through the stone gate; the fossil jaws slam shut behind.
success_means: jaws snapped at the gate with the runner beyond it

name: THE NAME APPEARS
phenomenon: Continuous running down the meadow slope in the lower third; sky left open for the logo.
success_means: runner stays in the lower 45% of frame, moving

name: CHASE UNDER THE TITLE
phenomenon: Drone pursuers close in as the runner hops the rail saw under the title.
success_means: brass drone within 450px while the runner clears the saw

name: THE CHASE TIGHTENS
setup: continues; cannon on the high step
move: Side follow; camera keeps title centered
phenomenon: Weaving up and down changing ledge heights past the spike pit and cannon fire.
success_means: runner's floor height changes by 55px+ twice

name: OOPS, DOWN AGAIN
setup: checkpoint 12, beside the post saw; a brass drone swoops from behind
phenomenon: An enemy strike knocks the runner into the saw.
success_means: runner hurt, then killed by the saw

name: CHECKPOINT RESTART
phenomenon: Respawn at the checkpoint flag beside the saw; running again at once.
success_means: runner respawned at checkpoint 12 and moving within 0.5s

name: WHAT ARE THOSE BLOCKS?
setup: continues; guardian builds awkward blocks over the spike bed
phenomenon: YOU builds blocks in odd places: a steep slanted stroke and a block too high.
success_means: two guardian platforms, one slanted >20 degrees

name: THAT WAS NOT THE PLAN
phenomenon: The runner scrambles across using the awkward blocks and the pillars, recovering onto the meadow.
success_means: runner touched a guardian block and reached the meadow at x>26700

name: AVAILABLE IN STORES
setup: meadow T4; brass drone and dipping saw ahead
move: Wide game scene on upper half
phenomenon: Upper half: running and dodging the dipping saw. Lower half left for the store card.
success_means: runner inside the upper 48% of the frame for the whole cut

name: COMING OCTOBER 2026
phenomenon: Ride the lift and collect the coin line.
success_means: runner in the upper 48%; a coin collected

name: CREATED BY
phenomenon: Final run over the bridge toward the goal flag.
success_means: runner in the upper 48% heading to the goal
